title: Sampling from multimodal distributions with warm starts: Non-asymptotic bounds for the Reweighted Annealed Leap-Point Sampler
abstract: arXiv:2512.17977v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sampling from multimodal distributions is a central challenge in Bayesian inference and machine learning. In light of hardness results for sampling -- classical MCMC methods, even with tempering, can suffer from exponential mixing times -- a natural question is how to leverage additional information, such as a warm start point for each mode, to enable faster mixing across modes. To address this, we introduce Reweighted ALPS (Re-ALPS), a modified version of the Annealed Leap-Point Sampler (ALPS) that dispenses with the Gaussian approximation assumption. We prove the first polynomial-time bound that works in a general setting, under a natural assumption that each component contains significant mass relative to the others when tilted towards the corresponding warm start point. translated_title: 基于热启动的多峰分布采样：重加权退火跳跃点采样器的非渐近界
translated_abstract: 从多峰分布中采样是贝叶斯推断和机器学习中的核心挑战。鉴于采样问题的困难性结果——经典MCMC方法即使采用回火技术，也可能面临指数级的混合时间——一个自然的问题是如何利用额外信息（例如每个模态的热启动点）来实现在各模态之间的更快混合。为解决这一问题，我们提出了重加权ALPS（Re-ALPS），这是退火跳跃点采样器（ALPS）的一个改进版本，它去除了高斯近似假设。在自然假设下——即当分布向相应的热启动点倾斜时，每个分量相对于其他分量包含显著的质量——我们证明了首个适用于一般设定的多项式时间界。与ALPS类似，我们定义了向以热启动点为中心的混合分布倾斜的分布，并在最冷层级上使用热启动点之间的传送机制。
tldr: 本文提出重加权退火跳跃点采样器（Re-ALPS），去除了ALPS的高斯近似假设，并在自然质量假设下证明了利用热启动点进行多峰分布采样的首个一般设定多项式时间收敛界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Reweighted ALPS (Re-ALPS), which removes the Gaussian approximation assumption of ALPS, and proves the first polynomial-time mixing bound in a general setting for sampling multimodal distributions with warm starts.
